purpose: Source-locked mathematical derivation needed to reconstruct Holcombe et al. 2016 six-parameter in-plane rib curves without guessing. This file is evidence, not yet a canonical HGPT rib curve.

thesis.title: The development of population-wide descriptions of human rib and ribcage geometry
thesis.author: Sven A. Holcombe
thesis.note: Search-indexed thesis text was used because the PDF endpoint returned 403 to direct fetch in this environment.

paper_2016.title: Modeling female and male rib geometry with logarithmic spirals

paper_2017.title: The effect of age and demographics on rib shape

coordinate_definition.normalized_rib_plane: proximal rib head/end is [0,0], distal costochondral endpoint is [1,0], peak is [Xpk,Ypk]; multiply final normalized coordinates by Sx for physical in-plane units.
coordinate_definition.distal_segment: logarithmic spiral from peak to distal endpoint
coordinate_definition.proximal_segment: logarithmic spiral joined to a tangent extension from the proximal endpoint to the spiral, then to the peak

distal_equations.2.5: theta_end is the first solution > theta_pk of (y(theta)-y(theta_pk))/(x(theta)-x(theta_pk)) = M

proximal_equations.2.11: theta_cut is the solution nearest pi/2 of atan2(-dx(theta), -dy(theta)) = -alpha
proximal_equations.2.16: Translate [x0,y(theta_cut)] to the origin, scale uniformly by SFp, then rotate by alpha so [x(theta_cut),y(theta_cut)] maps to [Xpk,Ypk].

source_constraints_2_18.unresolved_OCR_constraint: The second feasibility inequality in Eq. 2.18 is not sufficiently legible in the indexed text to transcribe safely; do not invent it.

hard_rules: Do not choose a theta_tangent branch merely because it produces a visually plausible curve.
Do not create a full canonical rib centreline until proximal branch selection and 3D orientation mapping are source-verified.
A distal-segment implementation may be used now because Eq. 2.2-2.7 and its first-solution rule are unambiguous.
Final rib 3D placement must still apply the sourced pump-handle, lateral-swing and bucket-handle orientation convention and thoracic attachment landmarks.

distal_verification.scope: Only distal source-mean segments; no proximal branch, head/tubercle contacts or thorax mapping
